ops.title: vcstest: give Repo an option for an exclusive PATH
ops.description:
Every test that needs a tool ABSENT currently hand-rolls
`t.Setenv("PATH", f.ShimBin)` after building the fixture, because
`vcstest.Repo`'s PATH appends the brew-free `systemPATH`, and `/usr/bin` is
where CI installs git and gh.

Discovered by a CI-only failure of `TestVcsInfoWithoutGh` (2026-08-03) after it
was converted off a PATH shell fake whose own PATH was exclusive.

Making it an Opt would put the reason in one place with a godoc, instead of a
comment at each call site. Small; the hand-rolled form is correct and explicit,
so this is ergonomics and discoverability rather than a defect.

ops.text: A fixture can be built whose PATH holds only its shim directory, so a test needing a tool absent does not hand-roll t.Setenv(PATH, f.ShimBin)
The option's godoc names the reason: systemPATH cannot exclude a tool installed in /usr/bin, which is where CI has git and gh
